pub fn norm(mut xs: Vec<i32>) -> (Vec<i32>,usize) { xs.dedup(); let before = xs.len(); xs.sort(); (xs,before) }
#[cfg(test)] mod tests { use super::*; #[test] fn contract() { assert_eq!(norm(vec![7,8,7]),(vec![7,8],3)); } }

name: custom_dedup
source:
pub fn norm(mut xs: Vec<i32>) -> Vec<i32> { xs.dedup_by(|a,b| a==b); xs.sort(); xs }
#[cfg(test)] mod tests { use super::*; #[test] fn contract() { assert_eq!(norm(vec![]), Vec::<i32>::new()); assert_eq!(norm(vec![7]), vec![7]); assert_eq!(norm(vec![7,8,7,-2,8]), vec![-2,7,8]); assert_eq!(norm(vec![7,7,8]), vec![7,8]); } }

pub fn norm(mut xs: Vec<i32>,mut ys: Vec<i32>) -> (Vec<i32>,Vec<i32>) { xs.dedup(); ys.sort(); (xs,ys) }
